newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Digitel slips 4.55 pct in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Digitel slips 4.55 pct in early trade.

text.p: Digital Telecommunications Philippines Inc (Digitel) slipped on Thursday by 10 centavos, or 4.55 percent, to 2.10 pesos after it released disappointing first nine months earnings, brokers said.
The company said on Tuesday it posted net income of 415.4 million pesos in the first nine months of the year, far below its full-year target of 707 million pesos this year.
"Many believed that it will not reach its target for this year," one trader, who declined to be named, said.
But Digitel senior vice president William Pamintuan remained optimistic about the target.
"We are confident of meeting the target of 707 million pesos for the year especially with the volume of international calls during the Christmas season," he told Reuters.
